骗子常冒充社安局、Medicare、中国警方或使馆，或假装孙辈出事要钱。记住三步: Scammers pose as Social Security, Medicare, Chinese police or an embassy, or pretend a grandchild is in trouble. Remember three steps: hang up, check on a number you already know, and never pay with gift cards, wire transfers or cash. Fraud against someone 60 or older: National Elder Fraud Hotline 833-372-8311. An elder losing money to someone they know: California Adult Protective Services 1-833-401-0832, 24 hours.

网络和电话诈骗报案；IC3 不会主动联系你要资料或要钱。: Report internet and phone scams; IC3 never contacts you for information or money.
骗子常打给长者：冒充社安局、Medicare、银行、中国警方或使馆，或者假装孙子: Scammers often call elders pretending to be Social Security, Medicare, a bank, Chinese police or an embassy, or a grandchild in trouble who needs money right away. The stories change every year; the pattern doesn't. Social Security lists four signs of a scam: they pretend to be from an organization you know; they say there's a problem or a prize; they pressure you to act immediately; they tell you to pay in a specific way.
三步应对：挂断、打回、不按指定方式付款: Three steps: hang up, call back, don't pay their way
先挂断或不回复。社安局建议：情绪一激动、觉得被催，就停下来深呼吸，找信得过的人商: Hang up or don't reply. Social Security's advice: if a message upsets you or you feel rushed, pause, take a deep breath and talk to someone you trust; don't click links or attachments in texts or emails.
用自己知道的号码打回去：家人用手机里存的号码，政府机构用官网上的号码。FTC 提: Call back on a number you know: the one saved in your phone for family, the one on the official website for an agency. The FTC says that if you can't reach the person, call someone else in your family or circle of friends, even if the caller asked you to keep it secret.
联系你的人要你买礼品卡、金条、预付卡、加密货币，或电汇、寄现金付款的，就是诈骗。: If someone who contacted you demands gift cards, gold bars, prepaid cards, cryptocurrency, a wire transfer or cash in the mail, it is a scam. Social Security says scammers insist on these because they are hard to trace.
冒充社安局：说要冻结你的社安号码或账户、要逮捕你，或要先交钱才能领生活费调整（C: Fake Social Security: they threaten to suspend your Social Security number or account, threaten arrest, or say you must pay to get a cost-of-living adjustment (COLA). Social Security says it will never ask for sensitive personal information through social media, email or text.
冒充“中国警方”或使馆：FBI 网络犯罪投诉中心（IC3）写明，这类骗局针对在美: Fake “Chinese police” or embassy: the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) says these schemes target the US-based Chinese community, tell you you're a suspect in a financial crime and threaten arrest or violence if you don't pay; the caller ID may be spoofed to look like a Public Security Bureau or a Chinese consulate. An official-looking number is not proof of official action.
亲人急事：电话里自称孙辈或亲戚，出了事要你马上转钱，还叫你别告诉别人。FTC 写: Family emergency: the caller says they're a grandchild or relative in trouble, needs money now and asks you not to tell anyone. The FTC says scammers claim it's urgent, that only you can help and that it must stay secret, and may ask you to buy gift cards and read them the numbers on the back.
冒充 Medicare：Medicare 写明，它不会打电话向你推销，也不会上门: Fake Medicare: Medicare says it will never call to sell you anything or visit your home. Give your Medicare card, Medicare number and Social Security number only to your doctor and people who should have them (such as insurers acting for you or a SHIP counselor).
“帮你保护存款”也是骗局: “Protecting your savings” is a scam too
社安局列出，骗子会叫你把钱转到“受保护的账户”，或者派人上门收现金、金条。: Social Security lists these tactics: telling you to move your money to a “protected” account, or sending someone to your door to collect cash or gold bars.
已经付了钱或给了资料，马上做这几件事: Already paid or shared information? Do this now
用银行卡或信用卡背面的号码打给银行，说明被骗，问能不能止付或冻结。: Call your bank on the number on the back of your card, say you were scammed and ask whether the payment can be stopped or the account frozen.

网上或电话骗局，到 FBI 的 IC3（ic3.gov）报案；冒充中国官员的，选: Report internet or phone scams to the FBI's IC3 (ic3.gov); for fake Chinese officials, choose the Chinese Authority Impersonation complaint. IC3 asks you to keep all original documents, emails, faxes and call logs, and to file even if you are unsure whether your complaint qualifies.
冒充 Medicare，或者账单上有没做过的服务，打 1-800-MEDICAR: For fake Medicare calls or services you never received on a statement, call 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227).
和社安局有关的诈骗，在社安局官网的诈骗页面（ssa.gov/scam）报告；任何: Report Social Security scams on SSA's scam page (ssa.gov/scam); any scam can also go to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

APS also refers you to other agencies. If someone is in danger right now, call 911 first.

Never give a Social Security number or money on such a call. IC3 also says it never contacts you for information or money.
